Title: Add loading state to AI exercise home screen
Description:
The AI exercise home screen is missing a loading state.

Acceptance criteria:
- A loading indicator appears while AI exercise content is loading.
- Empty, loading, error, and loaded states are visually distinct.
- Loading state matches the app's existing design patterns.

Note: This may duplicate an existing feedback ticket and can be merged if already imported.

Title: Localize chart labels
Description:
Chart labels are currently displayed in English instead of the active app language.

Acceptance criteria:
- Chart labels use localized strings.
- Polish locale displays Polish chart labels.
- Chart labels remain readable on small screens.

Title: Fix workout generation failure at step 4 of 5
Description:
Workout generation fails when the generation flow reaches step 4 of 5.

Acceptance criteria:
- Workout generation completes successfully from step 4 to step 5.
- Failure state is handled with a clear retry path.
- Relevant error details are logged for debugging.

Title: Add mocked premium purchase option
Description:
Add a mocked option to buy premium so the premium upgrade flow can be tested before real billing is implemented.

Acceptance criteria:
- User can see a premium purchase entry point.
- Purchase action is clearly mocked or uses a non-production flow.
- Mocked premium state can unlock premium UI paths for testing.

Title: Fix inability to add a new exercise
Description:
Users may be unable to add a new exercise from the workout flow.

Acceptance criteria:
- User can add a new exercise during an active workout.
- Added exercise appears immediately in the workout.
- Errors are surfaced if adding the exercise fails.

Title: Improve equipment and muscle filtering for bench press
Description:
Selecting barbell equipment and chest muscles did not surface flat bench press, which should be an expected result.

Acceptance criteria:
- Flat bench press appears for barbell + chest filter combinations.
- Exercise metadata for equipment and target muscles is reviewed.
- Filtered results include expected canonical exercises.

Title: Fix Live Activity for active workout and timer
Description:
Live Activity does not work correctly during an active workout or rest timer.

Acceptance criteria:
- Live Activity starts when expected during an active workout or rest timer.
- Live Activity updates timer state accurately.
- Live Activity ends when the workout or timer ends.

Note: This may duplicate an existing feedback ticket and can be merged if already imported.

Title: Fix Apple Watch connection
Description:
The app does not connect correctly with the watch integration.

Acceptance criteria:
- The mobile app can establish a watch connection when supported.
- Connection failures show an understandable state.
- Basic workout or timer data syncs according to the intended watch scope.

Title: Add explanation for why a workout was generated
Description:
Users should be able to understand why a generated workout contains specific exercises or structure.

Acceptance criteria:
- Generated workout includes an explanation entry point.
- Explanation references relevant user preferences, constraints, history, or goals.
- Explanation is concise and understandable during workout review.

Title: Show quick target muscle info for exercises
Description:
Users need quick information about what each exercise targets, for example back.

Acceptance criteria:
- Exercise UI shows primary target muscle or muscle group.
- Information is visible without opening full exercise details where appropriate.
- Muscle labels are localized.

Title: Allow limiting the number of exercises in generated workouts
Description:
Users should be able to constrain how many exercises are included in a generated workout.

Acceptance criteria:
- Workout generation preferences include a maximum exercise count.
- Generated workouts respect the configured limit.
- The app handles edge cases where too few exercises match the constraints.

Title: Add default set structure preference for new exercises
Description:
When creating or adding a new exercise, the default should be configurable, for example one warm-up set followed by three working sets.

Acceptance criteria:
- User can configure default set structure for newly added exercises.
- Defaults support warm-up sets and working sets.
- New exercises apply the configured default structure.

Title: Show previous sets in workout table
Description:
The workout table does not show previous sets, making progression and logging harder during a session.

Acceptance criteria:
- Workout table shows previous set values for the same exercise when available.
- Previous sets are visually distinct from current editable values.
- Missing history is handled gracefully.

Title: Use timer input for plank exercises instead of reps
Description:
Plank should be tracked with a timer or duration input instead of repetitions.

Acceptance criteria:
- Plank uses duration-based tracking by default.
- Duration-based exercises display appropriate inputs during workouts.
- Saved workout logs preserve duration values correctly.

Title: Fix exercise deletion
Description:
Deleting exercises does not work correctly.

Acceptance criteria:
- User can delete an exercise from the relevant workout or exercise management flow.
- Deleted exercise is removed from the UI and persisted state.
- Deletion handles confirmation or undo according to existing app patterns.

Title: Fix reversed gestures on exercise detail tabs
Description:
Gestures on exercise details feel reversed, and tab transitions should be more polished.

Acceptance criteria:
- Swipe gestures move between tabs in the expected direction.
- Tab transition animation feels smooth and intentional.
- Tapping tabs and swiping stay in sync.

Title: Show load context for maximum reps
Description:
Maximum reps should include information about the load used for that rep count.

Acceptance criteria:
- Max reps display includes the associated weight or load when available.
- Empty or unknown load values are handled clearly.
- Display remains compact in workout history or stats UI.

Title: Support assistance amount input for assisted exercises
Description:
Assisted exercises need an input for the amount of assistance used.

Acceptance criteria:
- Assisted exercises expose an assistance amount input.
- Assistance amount is saved with the set or workout log.
- Progression views can distinguish assisted load from regular external load.

Title: Add exercise images
Description:
Exercises should include images to make them easier to recognize and perform correctly.

Acceptance criteria:
- Exercise detail UI supports displaying an exercise image.
- Exercise list or workout UI uses thumbnails where appropriate.
- Missing images fall back to a polished placeholder.

Title: Copy previous row values when adding a new set
Description:
When adding a new set, the new row should start with values from the previous row to speed up logging.

Acceptance criteria:
- Adding a set copies relevant values from the previous set row.
- User can immediately edit the copied values.
- Copying does not apply when there is no previous row.

Title: Only warn about losing data when data was entered
Description:
The warning popup about losing entered data appears even when the user has not entered anything.

Acceptance criteria:
- Data loss warning appears only when there are unsaved user-entered values.
- No warning appears for untouched or empty forms.
- Dirty-state detection covers relevant workout input fields.
